decisions.reason: It was placed on the home page, builds directly on the core offer, and in a growing market management is likely to continue backing such a visibly committed product.
A dedicated page suggests meaningful investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely after only a short time on the market.
Although only lightly promoted, it extends the established messaging portfolio and management can still justify keeping it as part of the firm's multichannel business process direction.

As a close-to-core optimization feature with limited public prominence it is somewhat easier to discontinue, but the firm is still more likely to retain it because it supports the existing fax-related service base.
Threat protection fits the firm's security-led positioning well, and even with modest website visibility management has reason to persist given the strategic importance of secure communications.
Multi-engine virus scanning is closely aligned with the firm's secure messaging capabilities, so despite limited public commitment the product is likely to be kept rather than written off quickly.
